lines.en: label toukaspring7:
“Why?” you ask? I do not know. But she seems to have a destination in mind and {i}I{/i} seem to be both spineless and aimless, so I follow her without question.
lines.zh: 「为什么？」你问？{i}我{/i}不知道。但她好像心里有个目的地，而我又好像既没骨气又没方向，所以我一句话没问就跟了上去。

lines.en: Through the tunnels, down the tracks, and eventually onto the streets of the urban district that, while normally crowded for Kumon-mi, seem somewhat desolate tonight.
lines.zh: 穿过隧道、走下铁轨，最终来到市区的街上——对公文美来说这儿平常算热闹的，今晚却显得有些冷清。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
If she were a normal girl, I’m sure I’d be able to hear her walking beside me right now. But it’s only my footsteps that make any noise, and that tells me one of two things.
lines.zh: 要是她是个普通女孩，我这会儿肯定听得见她走在我旁边。可只有我的脚步声在响，这只能说明两件事之一。

lines.en: Either her forcefully trained elegance is impressive enough to conceal her presence and indefinitely hide her in plain sight-
lines.zh: 要么，她那被强行训练出来的优雅厉害到能掩去她的存在感、让她就这么「隐形」在明处——

lines.en: Or she’s just good enough at matching my pace to develop new levels of both synchronicity and synchronization that seem otherwise tragically spurious.
lines.zh: 要么，她只是太擅长跟我的步频保持一致，把「同步性」和「同步率」都拉到了一个新的高度——高到显得可悲地不真实。

lines.en: It makes me glad Carl Jung isn’t here. For he might try to take her from me. And she might follow for he’d be better {i}for{/i} her.
lines.zh: 这让我庆幸 Carl Jung 不在这儿。因为他可能会把她从我身边抢走。而她可能会跟走，因为他{i}对她{/i}更合适。

lines.en: Apart from the whole “death” thing, that is. But based on her affinity for horror, I feel like that might be less of an issue than I initially believed.
lines.zh: 除了「他已经死了」这一点之外。不过看她那么迷恐怖，我觉得那比我起初以为的要不算事。

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk1
: Just out of curiosity, what are your thoughts on necrophilia?
lines.zh: : 纯粹好奇问问，你对恋尸癖怎么看？

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, why are you curious?
lines.zh: : 纯粹好奇问问，你为什么好奇？

lines.en: : Are you in favor or not? Just answer the question.
lines.zh: : 你到底赞不赞成？直接回答问题。

lines.en: : Not.
lines.zh: : 不赞成。

lines.en: : Not even for that one guy you like?
lines.zh: : 就算是对你喜欢的那个男的也不赞成？

lines.en: : No, the other one.
lines.zh: : 不，另一个。

lines.en: : American movie star, Seth Rogen? Did I even tell you about that?
lines.zh: : 美国影星 Seth Rogen？我跟你说过他吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. If that guy was dead-
lines.zh: : 说过。要是那家伙死了——

lines.en: : Sensei, I’m not sure what you’re getting at, but I don’t think you’re going to be able to talk me into supporting sexual intercourse with a corpse.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我不知道你想说什么，但我觉得你没法说服我赞成跟尸体性交。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Touka. I did manage to talk you into thinking you needed to perform a special chant to operate a vending machine before.
lines.zh: : 我可说不准，Touka。我以前就成功让你以为，用自动贩卖机之前得先念一段特殊的咒语。

lines.en: : That may be true. But I am much smarter now than I was back then, and I’m hard-pressed to believe you could talk me into anything at all anymore.
lines.zh: : 那倒是真的。但我现在比那时聪明多了，而且我几乎敢肯定，你再也说服不了我做任何事了。

lines.en: : I also talked you into thinking condoms need to be refrigerated just a couple of hours ago.
lines.zh: : 几小时前我还刚让你以为避孕套得放冰箱呢。

lines.en: : You mean to tell me this was a lie and I ate a refrigerated condom for nothing?
lines.zh: : 你是说那是骗我的，我白吃了一个冰过的避孕套？

lines.en: : ...Did you actually eat one?
lines.zh: : ……你真吃了一个？

lines.en: : You told me I could and I was hungry.
lines.zh: : 是你说可以吃的，而且我饿了。

lines.en: : You are far more broken than I thought you were.
lines.zh: : 你比我想的还要「坏掉」得多。

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk2
: And you are just as easy to {i}convince{/i} as me. Of course I did not {i}eat{/i} a condom. And of course I would not have sex with the corpse of {i}anyone.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而你跟我一样好{i}骗{/i}。我当然没{i}吃{/i}避孕套。而且我当然不会跟{i}任何人{/i}的尸体做爱。

lines.en: : I mean, why {i}would{/i} I agree to such a thing when I don’t even know what sexual intercourse with the living feels like yet? You know, on account of the man I admire seeing me as a mother and all.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我连跟活人做爱是什么感觉都还不知道，怎么{i}会{/i}答应那种事？你知道的，毕竟我倾慕的那个男人把我当母亲看。

lines.en: : This changes nothing. It just makes the sex conceptually weirder.
lines.zh: : 这改变不了什么。只是让「性」这个概念更怪了。

lines.en: : Probably not as weird as you think. I looked deeper into it and found that Oedipal complexes aren’t all that uncommon in men after all. In fact, I may even be willing to embrace this role now.
lines.zh: : 可能没你想的那么怪。我深入查了一下，发现男人的俄狄浦斯情结其实并不少见。其实，现在我可能都愿意接受这个角色了。

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk3
: Assuming you {i}allow{/i} me to, of course. Even now, you seem quite hesitant when it comes to touching me.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是你{i}允许{/i}。就算现在，一到要碰我，你好像还是很犹豫。

lines.en: : Did I scare you by holding your hand earlier? Was that too {i}forward?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我刚才牵你的手吓到你了吗？是不是太{i}冒失{/i}了？

lines.en: : I was mostly just surprised you did it right in front of Yasu.
lines.zh: : 我主要是惊讶你当着 Yasu 的面就那么做。

lines.en: : Yasu is, as peculiar as it is to say, my best friend. I don’t mind if she knows about my feelings for you.
lines.zh: : Yasu 是——虽然这么说有点怪——我最好的朋友。我不介意她知道我对你有感觉。

lines.en: : And frankly, I don’t really care if anyone knows at this point. I entered the game very late and if this is what I must do to win, so be it.
lines.zh: : 而且说实话，到这地步我也不在乎还有谁知道。我入局太晚，如果这是我赢必须付出的代价，那就这样吧。

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk4
: Besides, if {i}I{/i} don’t, I’m beginning to think my mother will. Her obsession with you is becoming quite ridiculous, I must say.
lines.zh: : 再说，{i}我{/i}要不行动，我开始觉得我妈就要行动了。我必须说，她对你的迷恋正变得越来越离谱。

lines.en: : Oh, good. So it’s not just me who thinks that.
lines.zh: : 哦，那就好。看来不只是我一个人这么想。

lines.en: : Yeah, your mom is weird. And confusing. And scary. Like you, just turned up to eleven instead of like...two.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你妈又怪又让人费解又吓人。跟你一样，只是「音量」开到了十一，而不是……二。

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk5
: {i}Two?{/i} I’m far scarier than that. Do not underestimate my power just because I want to sleep with you.
lines.zh: : {i}二{/i}？我可远比那吓人。别因为我想跟你上床就小瞧我的能耐。

lines.en: : Technically speaking, I could have you kidnapped and forced into sexual slavery without anyone even knowing it happened. You should keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 严格说，我完全可以让人把你绑架、强迫你当性奴，而且没人会察觉。你可得记住这点。

lines.en: : It’s hard not to when it feels sometimes like that’s what your mom has planned on doing with me from the start.
lines.zh: : 很难不记住——尤其有时候感觉你妈从一开始就打算这么对我。

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk6
: {i}Hah...{/i}while it’s true that there may be some physical attraction at play here, I don’t think it’s the root cause of her obsession.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}虽然这里头可能确实有点肉体上的吸引，但我不觉得那是她「着迷」的根源。

lines.en: : Well, what is then? Because your insight is obviously far better than mine on account of actually knowing how she operates.
lines.zh: : 那根源是什么？因为你显然比我懂她那一套——你毕竟真了解她怎么运作。

lines.en: : It seems almost {i}debt-{/i}motivated to me. Similar to the ways in which she’s apparently attached to Yumi’s mother.
lines.zh: : 在我看来，那几乎像是出于{i}「欠债」{/i}。就跟她显然对 Yumi 的母亲那种执念差不多。

lines.en: : She owes Yuki some sort of debt? How? Yuki’s broke and your family practically owns this entire city.
lines.zh: : 她欠 Yuki 什么债？怎么会？Yuki 那么穷，你家又几乎坐拥这整座城。

lines.en: : That’s a good question. She seems a bit reluctant to open up about their past. So much so that I might even think the two of them were partners if they weren’t so...heterosexual.
lines.zh: : 问得好。她似乎不太愿意透露她们的过去。甚至到了——要不是她俩都那么……异性恋——我几乎要怀疑她们曾是一对儿的地步。

lines.en: : I think your mom just likes having things to play with. And people are very interactive toys.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你妈就是手里得有东西玩。而人是非常「互动」的玩具。

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk7
: They are, yes. But there’s much more to it than that. And I actually think she’d be quite distraught if anything happened to either you or {i}Yuki.{/i}
lines.zh: : 确实是。但远不止如此。而且我其实觉得，要是你或 {i}Yuki{/i} 出了什么事，她会相当难过。

lines.en: : Well, at least I know who to turn to if I suddenly get cancer.
lines.zh: : 好吧，至少我知道哪天我突然得了癌症该找谁了。

lines.en: : Are you really sure you don’t {i}know{/i} her, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你真确定你不{i}认识{/i}她吗，Sensei？

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk8
s" Who? Your mom? I obviously know her."
lines.zh: : 「谁？你妈？我当然认识她。」

lines.en: : No, you dunce. I mean on a level much greater than the one that began when she enrolled me in your class.
lines.zh: : 不，你这呆子。我是说，比「她把我送进你班上才开始」深得多的那种认识。

lines.en: : For example, is it possible that you knew her {i}before{/i} me and just happened to forget about her? Some sort of fleeting connection or something?
lines.zh: : 比如说，有没有可能你在我{i}之前{/i}就认识她，只是恰好忘了？某种转瞬即逝的交集之类的？

lines.en: : That seems unlikely. There’s a lot about my past that’s sort of...intentionally fuzzy. But I have no idea where your mom would come into play or how we’d even cross paths at all.
lines.zh: : 不太可能。我的过去有很多地方本来就……故意模糊。但我完全不知道你妈会在哪儿出现，我们又能有什么交集。

lines.en: : Hm. But what if she knew someone that you did? Yuki is somewhat close to your age, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 嗯。可万一她认识你认识的某个人呢？Yuki 跟你的年纪多少有点接近，对吧？

lines.en: : She’s got almost a decade on me, I think.
lines.zh: : 她好像比我大快十岁。

lines.en: : Perhaps a family member then? I just can’t see why she’d be so interested if-
lines.zh: : 那也许是某个家人？我就是想不通，不然她为什么这么感兴趣——

lines.en: : I’d prefer not speaking about my family, if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 可以的话，我不想谈我的家人。

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk9
: Out of discomfort or a lack of trust?
lines.zh: : 是出于抵触，还是不信任？

lines.en: : I trust you. It just brings back bad memories.
lines.zh: : 我信你。只是那会勾起不好的回忆。

lines.en: : I see. Then perhaps we should take a reprieve from this conversation altogether and get something to eat.
lines.zh: : 这样。那我们也许该干脆放下这个话题，去吃点东西。

lines.en: : Is sushi okay? There’s a spot not far from here that I highly recommend. And I should be able to get us in despite the lack of a reservation given how important and wealthy I am.
lines.zh: : 寿司行吗？离这儿不远有家我很推荐的。而且凭我多有分量、多有钱，就算没预约也能让我们进去。

lines.en: : Will they not question someone like me accompanying you? You know, given how important and wealthy you are.
lines.zh: : 他们不会质疑「我这种人」陪着你吗？你知道的，就凭你多有分量、多有钱。

lines.en: : I’m sure they will. But there’s a certain level of wealth one can reach where that’s no longer an issue since questioning {i}anything{/i} about me would be intimidating given the difference in power.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定他们会。但财富到了一定程度，那就不再是问题了——因为考虑到权势差距，质疑我{i}任何事{/i}都会让他们发怵。

lines.en: : So you’re just allowed to get away with stuff other people wouldn’t?
lines.zh: : 所以你就能干别人干了会被拦、而你没事的事？

lines.en: : Essentially, yes.
lines.zh: : 基本上，是的。

lines.en: : Maybe I’m secretly wealthy too then? Because I do that every day.
lines.zh: : 那说不定我也偷偷很有钱？因为我天天都那样。

lines.en: : Hurry up and find out, if you can. It’ll be far easier pitching our relationship to my father if you come from nobility.
lines.zh: : 那你赶紧去弄清楚。你要是出身名门，向我父亲「推销」我们的关系会容易得多。

lines.en: scene black
: Or you could just...not do that. Fathers and me don’t really mix on account of how much sex I have with their daughters.
lines.zh: : 或者你也可以干脆……别推销。父亲们跟我处不来，因为我跟他们女儿睡得太多了。

lines.en: : Yes, brag some more, why don’t you? I’m not jealous or hormonal at all.
lines.zh: : 对，接着吹，你倒是吹啊。我可一点都没吃醋、也没荷尔蒙上脑。

lines.en: : You have servants to address that problem, I think.
lines.zh: : 你有佣人可以解决这个问题，我想。

lines.en: : You’d hate that and you know it.
lines.zh: : 你会讨厌那样的，你心知肚明。

lines.en: : I think you would too, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得你也会讨厌。

lines.en: : Heh.
: Probably even more than you.
lines.zh: : 可能比你更讨厌。

lines.en: Touka treats me to a fancy and surprisingly lengthy omakase course at a sushi restaurant that, no surprise, recognizes her immediately upon entry.
lines.zh: Touka 请我在一家寿司店吃了一顿讲究又出奇地长的「主厨发办」。毫不意外，店家一进门就认出了她。

lines.en: They seem more confused by her manner of dress than the fact that she’s accompanied by an older man, though, so I manage to dodge whatever bullet you’d associate with that.
lines.zh: 不过，他们好像更被她的穿着搞糊涂，而不是「她身边跟着个年长男人」这件事——所以我算是躲过了跟这相关的任何麻烦。

lines.en: Touka, unperturbed and elegant as ever, treats this like it’s completely normal, though. And that only further emphasizes the gap between us.
lines.zh: 而 Touka 一如既往地面不改色、举止优雅，把这一切当作天经地义。这只会更凸显我们之间的鸿沟。

lines.en: Which gets me thinking — if I {i}do{/i} wind up with her by some stretch of fortune or {i}disfortune{/i} based on how you look at it, would I feel this way forever? Would the gap always be this clear?
lines.zh: 这让我想到——要是我{i}真{/i}因为某种幸运或{i}不幸{/i}（看你怎么定义）跟她走到一起，我会一辈子都是这种感觉吗？这道鸿沟会永远这么分明吗？

lines.en: Or is there a point where it might become comforting? Where I could genuinely believe I’m something I’m not.
lines.zh: 还是说，会有那么一个节点，它反而会变成安慰？一个我能真心相信「我是我不是的东西」的节点。

lines.en: I take this question and expand on it, wondering how to rewrite it into some scenario where I can see myself as anything but scum.
lines.zh: 我把这个问题展开，琢磨怎么把它改写成某个能让我觉得自己「不是人渣」的剧本。

lines.en: But the final course comes before I think up an ending. And I find myself, once again, taken somewhere I shouldn’t be with someone who should have never taken me there at all.
lines.zh: 可还没等我想出结局，最后一道菜就上来了。而我发现自己又一次被一个「本就不该带我来」的人，带到了「我本就不该来」的地方。

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk10
: I’m surprised they just let you up here. I think I’d be a little more careful when it comes to the safety of an heiress, personally.
lines.zh: : 我挺意外他们就这么放你上来了。换我，对一个女继承人的安全会再小心一点。

lines.en: : My virginity is direct proof of that. Now, if only you’d offer the same chivalrous protection when it comes to my mental health. Why is my body the only thing you keep “safe,” Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我的「处子之身」就是直接的证据。现在，要是你对我的「心理健康」也能提供同样骑士风度的保护就好了。Sensei，为什么你「守护」的只有我的身体？

lines.en: : You {i}really{/i} like me now, huh? You’re coming on strong tonight.
lines.zh: : 你现在{i}真{/i}喜欢我了，是吧？你今晚攻势很猛。

lines.en: : {size=-2}Yes, well, I’ve been giving you signals for so long just to have them ignored that I feel like the time has come for me to flash my lights in your eyes to the point where you must address them posthaste.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}是，这个嘛，我给你暗示给了那么久，你却一直无视，所以我觉得是时候把「灯」打到你眼前，逼你立刻正视了。{/size}

lines.en: : Ahh, so you brought me up here for sex. You really want your first time to be on a roof while that creepy billboard lady looks down on us?
lines.zh: : 啊，所以你带我来这儿是为了做爱。你真想把你的第一次放在天台上、让那个诡异的广告牌女郎俯视我们？

lines.en: : No one ever looks down on me. It doesn’t matter how high up they are.
lines.zh: : 从没人俯视我。他们站得多高都没用。

lines.en: : I do, sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我偶尔会俯视你。

lines.en: : Ahh, then maybe {i}that’s{/i} why I find you so attractive? You’re different.
lines.zh: : 啊，{i}那{/i}也许正是我觉得你有魅力的原因？你不一样。

lines.en: : I don’t really mind if it’s you, though. I think I can handle being looked down on so long as it gets you to look at me.
lines.zh: : 不过，要是是你的话，我倒不介意被俯视。我觉得，只要能换来你看着我，被俯视我也受得住。

lines.en: : Oh, I look at you alright. You make it...quite difficult not to.
lines.zh: : 哦，我当然看着你。你让我……很难不看你。

lines.en: : Practice daily and it might become easier. Or not. Either way, I win.
lines.zh: : 每天练习，或许就会变得容易些。也可能不会。不管怎样，都是我赢。

lines.en: if tsukasaspring6 == True:
: Sensei...I feel as if I need to address the situation with my sister. And I don’t know when the next chance I’ll get to do that {i}is,{/i} so-
lines.zh: : Sensei……我觉得我得跟你谈谈我妹妹的事。我不知道下次还{i}有没有{/i}机会说，所以——

lines.en: : You don’t need to, Touka. I know it makes you uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 你不必说，Touka。我知道那让你不舒服。

lines.en: : Yes, it does. But it makes {i}you{/i} uncomfortable as well. So I think we can both be a little uncomfortable for a moment if it helps...somehow lead to something good.
lines.zh: : 是，确实。但那也让{i}你{/i}不舒服。所以我想，我们俩都不舒服一会儿也没关系，只要这能……以某种方式带来点好结果。

lines.en: : Right. And how does {i}this{/i} lead to anything good, exactly?
lines.zh: : 行。那{i}这{/i}到底怎么能带来好结果？

lines.en: : Well, you know the situation, don’t you? Regarding Tsukasa and...her future both inside and...{i}outside{/i} of the Tsukioka family.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，你了解情况的，对吧？关于 Tsukasa，以及她……在月冈家内{i}外{/i}的……未来。

lines.en: : Tsukasa and I are not particularly close.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 跟我不太亲。

lines.en: : We never {i}have{/i} been as we were never really given the chance to be.
lines.zh: : 从来就{i}不亲{/i}，因为我们从没得到过亲近的机会。

lines.en: : Our schedules were just far too different and, with me being groomed into the future matriarch of my family, putting the two of us together for the sake of socialization just seemed like a waste.
lines.zh: : 我们的日程差得太远，而且我又是被当作家族未来女家长培养的——为了「社交」把我俩凑到一起，显得像种浪费。

lines.en: : But she is still my sister. And the thought of her being used as a tool like this infuriates me. Even if {i}she{/i} often infuriates me as well.
lines.zh: : 可{i}她{/i}终究是我妹妹。一想到她被当成工具使唤，我就火大。哪怕她自己也常常让我火大。

lines.en: : If only your mother felt the same.
lines.zh: : 要是你母亲也这么想就好了。

lines.en: : I think she {i}does.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我想她{i}是这么想的{/i}。

lines.en: : I don’t think she {i}wants{/i} to do this, but I think she {i}has{/i} to for some reason.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得她{i}想{/i}这么做，但我觉得她出于某种原因{i}不得不{/i}做。

lines.en: : Which is utterly {i}absurd{/i} to me since there’s no family I can think of that can give us {i}anything{/i} we don’t already have.
lines.zh: : 这在我看来荒唐至极，因为我想不出有哪个家族能给我们{i}任何{/i}「我们没有的东西」。

lines.en: : And this...nonsense. What with you tutoring her on the topic of {i}sexual education...{/i}that’s the most absurd thing of all.
lines.zh: : 还有这……荒唐事。让你在{i}「性教育」{/i}这个话题上辅导她……这才是最荒唐的。

lines.en: : Like, I understand you being her tutor for {i}other{/i} subjects. Tsukasa has taken a liking to you and doesn’t see our father often, so you’ve basically taken over as {i}the{/i} man in her life.
lines.zh: : 我是说，你辅导她{i}别的{/i}科目我能理解。Tsukasa 挺喜欢你，又不常见到我们的父亲，所以你基本上接管了她生命里{i}「男性角色」{/i}的位置。

lines.en: : Well, maybe your father should start actually being a father. No offense.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那你父亲也许该开始真正当个父亲。无意冒犯。

lines.en: : There {i}should{/i} be offense. And the fact that he’d allow this to happen disgusts me. Perhaps even more than the fact that my mother would seemingly {i}endorse{/i} it.
lines.zh: : {i}该{/i}冒犯。而且他居然容许这种事发生，让我恶心。甚至可能比我母亲对此显得{i}「赞同」{/i}还让我恶心。

lines.en: : That said...I think choosing {i}you{/i} is an act of self-sabotage, in a sense. Like she’s screaming at you to ruin this arrangement, but the single sliver of pride you still possess is telling you not to.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此……我觉得选{i}你{/i}在某种意义上是一种「自毁」。就好像她在冲你大喊，让你毁了这桩安排，可你仅剩的那一丁点自尊又在叫你别那么做。

lines.en: : That’s exactly right. The last part, at least. I have barely anything left and it’s like she’s trying to set it on fire and leave me with literally {i}nothing.{/i}
lines.zh: : 正是如此。至少后半句是。我几乎什么都不剩了，而她好像要把那点火点着，让我真的彻底{i}一无所有{/i}。

lines.en: : I hope you know she doesn’t want that for you, Sensei. She does care.
lines.zh: : 我希望你知道，她并不想那样对你，Sensei。她是在乎的。

lines.en: : Then she should act like it and respect my boundaries. Teasing a starved lion with raw meat is just fucked up.
lines.zh: : 那她就该拿出在乎的样子，尊重我的底线。拿生肉去逗一头饿狮，简直是缺德到家。

lines.en: : The fact that you’d describe yourself as a “starved lion” is quite dark, isn’t it? You {i}want{/i} the raw meat.
lines.zh: : 你把自己形容成「饿狮」，挺黑暗的，不是吗？你{i}想{/i}要那块生肉。

lines.en: : Of {i}course{/i} I want the raw meat. I’m a fucking carnivore.
lines.zh: : 我{i}当然{/i}想要生肉。我他妈是食肉动物。

lines.en: : A vampire starved of human blood who must now feast on animals to survive. Who knows that biting humans is wrong, but still feels the temptation to do so.
lines.zh: : 一头被断绝人血、只能以兽血为生的吸血鬼。明知咬人不对，却仍抵不住那种诱惑。

lines.en: : Bingo.
lines.zh: : 说中了。

lines.en: : And {i}I{/i} am an animal.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}是只动物。

lines.en: : More like some kind of hybrid. I shouldn’t be drinking your blood either, but I’m going to anyway.
lines.zh: : 更像某种杂交种。我也不该吸你的血，但反正我也要吸。

lines.en: : Mm...you poor thing, you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你这可怜的家伙。

lines.en: : Don’t give me your pity, please. That’s not going to help.
lines.zh: : 请别把你的怜悯给我。那没用。

lines.en: : I know that. But I’m not going to shy away from expressing myself just because you don’t {i}like{/i} said expression.
lines.zh: : 我知道。但我不会因为你不{i}喜欢{/i}某种表达，就躲开不去表达。

lines.en: : This is tough for me too, you know. I have fallen for you and it seems that, right now, the only way to save my sister from her fate is for you to take her.
lines.zh: : 这对我来说也很难，你知道吗。我爱上了你，而眼下看来，要把我妹妹从她的命运里救出来，唯一的办法就是你「要了她」。

lines.en: : There {i}has{/i} to be another way. I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : {i}肯定{/i}有别的办法。我不懂。

lines.en: : Yes...neither do I. And I feel as if I {i}won’t{/i} understand for a very long time...
lines.zh: : 是的……我也不懂。而且我觉得，很长很长时间内我都{i}不会{/i}明白……

lines.en: : But my mother seems to believe that {i}you{/i} are the answer for some reason. And everything I’ve learned about you pushes me to think she’s right. I just don’t know {i}why.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可我母亲似乎出于某种原因相信{i}你{/i}就是答案。而我了解到的关于你的一切，都在推着我认为她是对的。我只是不知道{i}为什么{/i}。

lines.en: : {size=-2}Perhaps you {i}are{/i} special in some way? And that this...indebted manner of which she approaches your relationship transcends the way it appears to us and actually makes sense when you have all the pieces?{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}也许你在某方面确实「特殊」？而她这种带着「欠债感」对待你们关系的方式，超出了我们看到的表象，等你掌握了所有「碎片」就真的讲得通了？{/size}

lines.en: : What “pieces” could make this make sense, Touka?
lines.zh: : 什么样的「碎片」能让这一切讲得通，Touka？

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk11
: Do you know what I heard the other day, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你知道我前几天听到了什么吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Beats me. But if it’s about {i}who{/i} your sister is getting peddled onto, I don’t want to know.
lines.zh: : 不知道。不过要是关于你妹妹要被许配给{i}谁{/i}，我不想知道。

lines.en: : It was something about Ami. Her mother, specifically. Does {i}that{/i} pique your interest?
lines.zh: : 是关于 Ami 的。具体说，是她母亲。{i}这{/i}勾起你的兴趣了吗？

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk12
: Oh, it appears that it does.
lines.zh: : 哦，看来是勾起了。

lines.en: : What could you have possibly heard about her and why? She has nothing to do with you.
lines.zh: : 你能听说她什么，又是为什么？她跟你一点关系都没有。

lines.en: : It was just a rumor. Quite a morbid one, at that. Something about her body being buried beneath my family’s sakura tree.
lines.zh: : 只是条传闻。而且是条相当阴森的传闻。好像是说她的遗体被埋在我家那棵樱花树下。

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk13
: What?...
: Have you heard anything about that?
lines.zh: : 你听说过这事吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...no? What? Why? How? It’s not...there’s no way that’s...I mean, I visit her {i}grave.{/i} She and my brother are both-
lines.zh: : 呃……没有？什么？为什么？怎么会？那不……不可能……我是说，我去扫过她的{i}墓{/i}。她和我哥哥都——

lines.en: : It’s not true. My mother assured me of it. But there’s apparently a poem she left behind about being buried beneath one that led {i}Nodoka{/i} of all people to my family’s manor.
lines.zh: : 那不是真的。我母亲向我保证过了。但显然她留下过一首诗，写到「被埋在一棵樱花树下」，而正是这首诗，把 {i}Nodoka{/i} 那样的人引来了我家大宅。

lines.en: : It seems she’s quite interested in this matter.
lines.zh: : 看来她对这事挺感兴趣。

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk14
: Yeah, well...Nodoka’s interested in a lot of things she shouldn’t be. And if she’s curious about Ami’s mom, she’s learned a much easier way to {i}find things out.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊，这个嘛……Nodoka 对很多她不该感兴趣的事都感兴趣。而且她要是好奇 Ami 的母亲，早就学会了一条省事的{i}打听{/i}路子。

lines.en: : What a peculiar thing to say. I’d love to ask you more about it if you were not so upset right now.
lines.zh: : 这话真怪。要不是你此刻这么激动，我真想多问你几句。

lines.en: : I’m not upset. I know where to find her if {i}I{/i} ever become interested in necrophilia.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}没激动。我知道哪天我真对恋尸癖来了兴致，去哪儿找她。

lines.en: : You loved her dearly, didn’t you? That’s where this {i}mother{/i} thing comes from.
lines.zh: : 你深爱过她，对吧？你对「{i}母亲{/i}」这份执念就是这么来的。

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk15
: Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : Is Ami {i}your{/i} daughter? Or are you really just her uncle?
lines.zh: : Ami 是{i}你的{/i}女儿吗？还是说，你当真只是她的叔叔？

lines.en: : She’s not mine.
lines.zh: : 她不是我的孩子。

lines.en: : Do you know for sure?
lines.zh: : 你确定？

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk16
: She’s {i}not{/i} mine.
lines.zh: : 她{i}不是{/i}我的孩子。

lines.en: : What does any of this have to do with Tsukasa, Touka? Why are you bringing {i}her{/i} up, of all people?
lines.zh: : 这些跟 Tsukasa 到底有什么关系，Touka？你为什么偏偏把{i}她{/i}扯进来？

lines.en: : I just wonder if she and my mother were acquainted. It would sure explain a lot of things, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我只是在想，她跟我母亲会不会相识。那样就能解释很多事了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Like what?
lines.zh: : 比如什么？

lines.en: : This apparent and alleged {i}debt,{/i} for one. Perhaps the two of them had some sort of promise?
lines.zh: : 首先就是那个明显又据称存在的{i}「债」{/i}。也许她们俩之间有过某种约定？

lines.en: : A promise? What, like, “Hey, if I ever suddenly die, make sure you get the boy I’m having sex with to fuck your daughters?” Sounds perfectly logical.
lines.zh: : 约定？什么样的，「嘿，要是我哪天突然死了，记得让那个跟我上床的男孩去上你的女儿们」？听着逻辑满分。

lines.en: : There’s no need to get sarcastic with me. I know how ridiculous this all sounds.
lines.zh: : 没必要跟我阴阳怪气。我知道这听起来有多离谱。

lines.en: : I’m just saying...it would be a very convenient way to tie all of this together and have it make {i}some{/i} amount of sense.
lines.zh: : 我只是说……那会是个把这一切串起来、让它{i}多少{/i}讲得通的便捷法子。

lines.en: : I still don’t think it makes any sense at all. And that having me do {i}anything{/i} sexual with Tsukasa, whether it be teaching or defiling her, will do way more harm than good.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得根本讲不通。而且，让我跟 Tsukasa 发生{i}任何{/i}性关系——不管是「教」她还是玷污她——都只会弊大于利。

lines.en: : It’s hard to ever know for sure. There are many things out there even scarier than me. Things we can’t and won’t understand. Things {i}bigger{/i} than us. That can’t be conquered with logic alone.
lines.zh: : 这种事永远说不准。世上有很多比我还可怕的东西。我们无法、也不会理解的东西。比我们{i}更大{/i}的东西。光靠逻辑征服不了的东西。

lines.en: : You don’t have to tell me twice...I experience just that all the fucking time.
lines.zh: : 这不用你多说……我他妈天天都在经历这个。

lines.en: : You could always {i}lie,{/i} you know.
lines.zh: : 你随时可以{i}撒谎{/i}，你知道吧。

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk17
: What?...
scene toukanightwalk18
: Take a page out of my mother’s book. If the truth isn’t convenient enough, just make up your own version of it.
lines.zh: : 学学我母亲。真相不够方便，就自己编一个。

lines.en: : Perhaps it’s more important for people to {i}believe{/i} that you and Tsukasa have crossed some sort of line than it is for you to actually {i}cross{/i} it?
lines.zh: : 也许，让人{i}相信{/i}你和 Tsukasa 「越过了某条线」，比你真的{i}越过{/i}它更重要？

lines.en: : Why involve me at all then? Why can’t she just lie on her own?
lines.zh: : 那干嘛还扯上我？她就不能自己撒这个谎？

lines.en: : Perhaps {i}she{/i} needs to believe it too? I don’t know. These are all just ideas.
lines.zh: : 也许{i}她{/i}也需要「相信」？我不知道。这些都只是猜想。

lines.en: : But what {i}I{/i} said sounds far better than what she proposed, yes? Even if you {i}are{/i} some sort of {i}vampire.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但{i}我{/i}说的这个办法，听着比她提的好多了，对吧？哪怕你{i}真是{/i}某种{i}吸血鬼{/i}。

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. If it’s that easy, I’ll gladly do it. I don’t want Tsukasa getting married off, either. I just know it {i}won’t{/i} be that easy.
lines.zh: : 我是说……是啊。要真那么容易，我很乐意照做。我也不想让 Tsukasa 被嫁出去。我只知道{i}没那么容易{/i}。

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, have you ever seen or read “Twilight,” Sensei?
lines.zh: : 纯粹好奇，你看过或读过《暮光之城》吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Is that another horror movie, or something?
lines.zh: : 那是又一部恐怖片还是什么？

lines.en: : In a sense, yes. Though, mostly just because it’s terrible. But there’s something that happens in one of the books that seems somewhat relevant here. And it raises an interesting question.
lines.zh: : 从某种意义上说，是。不过主要是因为它烂。但其中一本书里有段情节，跟这儿多少有点相关。它引出一个有趣的问题。

lines.en: : If someone you cared for was dying, and the only way to {i}save{/i} them was by sinking your fangs into their flesh, could you do it?
lines.zh: : 如果你在乎的人快死了，而{i}救{/i}他们的唯一办法是把你的尖牙扎进他们的血肉，你下得了口吗？

lines.en: : It would only have to be once. And no one would think any less of you. Why, you’d be a hero.
lines.zh: : 只需要咬一次。而且没人会因此看轻你。恰恰相反，你会成为英雄。

lines.en: : It would just also change the person you bit for the rest of their life.
lines.zh: : 只是，这也会永远改变那个被你咬的人。

lines.en: : Just some food for thought. I know you’ll find a way to solve this problem at the end of the day. And, once you do, you can keep the methodology employed a secret from me.
lines.zh: : 仅供参考。我相信你到最后总会找到解决这个问题的办法。而且，等你找到了，你用的法子可以对我保密。

lines.en: : Why {i}me?{/i} Why do {i}I{/i} have to solve this problem? I’m not even a {i}part{/i} of your family.
lines.zh: : 为什么是{i}我{/i}？为什么非得{i}我{/i}来解决这个问题？我都不是{i}你家的人{/i}。

lines.en: : Not in name or blood, no. But you {i}are{/i} a part of us, Sensei. {i}Akira.{/i}
lines.zh: : 论姓氏和血缘，确实不是。但你{i}是{/i}我们中的一员，Sensei。{i}Akira{/i}。

lines.en: : Whether you like it not, we’ve already abducted you. We’re just kind enough to let you roam around on your own.
lines.zh: : 不管你乐不乐意，我们早就把你「绑架」了。只是好心到肯放你到处自由活动罢了。

lines.en: scene toukanightwalk19
: I hate rich people. You guys find it way too easy to turn the rest of us into puppets.
lines.zh: : 我讨厌有钱人。你们把别人变成傀儡也太容易了。

lines.en: : Hah! Oh, please. Your strings are far too tangled for any of us to manipulate them at all. All {i}we{/i} can do is just poke you and make you swing or sway a little.
lines.zh: : 哈！哦，得了吧。你的线缠得太乱，我们谁也操纵不了。{i}我们{/i}能做的，只是戳戳你，让你晃一晃、摆一摆。

lines.en: : Well, could you quit it? Life was easier before I had to figure out whether or not to have sex with a little girl.
lines.zh: : 那你能不能别戳了？在我还不用纠结「要不要跟一个小女孩上床」之前，日子轻松多了。

lines.en: : And when was that, I wonder? When did all of this {i}begin?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那是什么时候呢，我很好奇？这一切是什么时候{i}开始{/i}的？

lines.en: : I have no reason to tell you that...
lines.zh: : 我没理由告诉你……

lines.en: : No, I suppose you don’t. But you {i}will.{/i} In time.
lines.zh: : 是，你确实没理由。但你{i}会{/i}说的。总有一天。

lines.en: : After all, what’s the point of having a mother if you can’t confide in her?
lines.zh: : 毕竟，有个「母亲」却不能向她倾诉，那要母亲何用？

lines.en: : Touka-
lines.zh: : Touka——

lines.en: : I apologize. I’ve rambled a bit too much when we should be {i}cherishing{/i} a view like this, yes? It’ll only gray with time.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我絮叨得太多了，我们本该好好{i}欣赏{/i}这样的景色，对吧？它只会随时间渐渐褪色。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Which means that, one day, we likely won’t see color at all. And that these moments of wistful splendor will pass like a mild sunshower.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，有一天我们大概再也看不见任何颜色。而这些惆怅又绚烂的时刻，会像一场小太阳雨一样过去。

lines.en: : Which isn’t much of a problem for me, of course. I always carry an umbrella just in case.
lines.zh: : 当然，这对我算不上什么问题。我总是随身带把伞以防万一。

lines.en: : It’d be nice to have someone to hold it for me, though. Someone who might glisten under the light of the sun.
lines.zh: : 不过，要是有个人替我撑伞就好了。一个或许能在阳光下闪闪发亮的人。

lines.en: : Vampires die in the sun, Touka.
lines.zh: : 吸血鬼在太阳下会死的，Touka。

lines.en: : Heh...
scene black
: Maybe you and I {i}should{/i} watch Twilight next.
lines.zh: : 也许咱俩下次{i}该{/i}看看《暮光之城》。

lines.en: else:
: You know, it’s funny.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，挺有意思的。

lines.en: : I feel as if there’s something I want to say here. And that, in another life, I probably could. Probably {i}would.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我总觉得此刻有句话想说。而且，在另一世里，我大概说得出。大概也真{i}会{/i}说。

lines.en: : But it seems wrong in this one. And that if I say anything at all that tears us away from here and now, I might wind up regretting it for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 可在这一世，说出来好像不对。而且，只要我开口说任何把我们拽离「此时此地」的话，我可能会后悔一辈子。

lines.en: : So you just won’t say anything, then?
lines.zh: : 所以你就干脆什么都不说？

lines.en: : Will you? Did I jump the gun and break the silence before you could confess your love to me?
lines.zh: : 那你会说吗？我是不是抢在你向我表白之前，先打破了沉默？

lines.en: : Yeah. Which is really unfortunate, because I’ve questioned everything over the last thirty seconds and just don’t really think I have it in me to actually do that now.
lines.zh: : 对。这就很可惜了，因为过去这三十秒我质疑了一切，现在实在没力气真说出口了。

lines.en: : Alas, my incessant need to draw your attention has spelled my downfall once more.
lines.zh: : 唉，我这停不下来的「想引起你注意」的毛病，又一次害惨了我。

lines.en: : Will this life ever get better for me?
lines.zh: : 我这辈子还会有好起来的一天吗？

lines.en: scene black
: Better than being the richest girl in Kumon-mi? Who can get a seat at any restaurant and wander onto any roof except the one that matters?
lines.zh: : 好过「当公文美最有钱的女孩」？好过「能在任何餐厅订到位子、能走上任何天台，唯独除了真正重要的那一个」？

lines.en: : Yes, I- wait a moment. Which roof is the one that matters? What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 是的，我——等等。哪个天台才是「真正重要的那个」？那到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : Something that would make your life definitively {i}worse{/i} if you knew. So perhaps I should go back to keeping my mouth shut and just let you ramble a little longer.
lines.zh: : 那是一件你一旦知道、日子就铁定会{i}更糟{/i}的事。所以我也许还是继续闭嘴、让你再多絮叨一会儿比较好。

lines.en: : Heh...I’m not sure if that’s a good idea.
lines.zh: : 呵……我不确定那是不是个好主意。

lines.en: : For I feel quite compelled to say something very stupid right now.
lines.zh: : 因为我现在特别想说一句非常蠢的话。

lines.en: We stay up there for another hour or two, just looking out at the lights and wondering if and when they’ll turn off.
lines.zh: 我们又在天台上待了一两个小时，只是望着那些灯火，猜它们会不会、又会在何时熄灭。

lines.en: The streets are even emptier now than they were before, and it’s only getting worse.
lines.zh: 街上比刚才更空了，而且只会越来越空。

lines.en: But even with how “bad” it gets, there’s one thing that doesn’t change.
lines.zh: 可不管变得多「糟」，有一样东西不会变。

lines.en: Her confident silence. How she’s invisible until she speaks, even with how massive her presence is as both a girl {i}and{/i} a woman.
lines.zh: 她那自信的沉默。尽管作为一个女孩、{i}又{/i}作为一个女人，她的存在感都那么强，可不开口时，她就是「隐形」的。

lines.en: And I hate that I see her that way.
lines.zh: 而我讨厌自己这样看她。

lines.en: But I love how I see her that way.
lines.zh: 但我又爱自己这样看她。

lines.en: Yet I’ll never understand this peculiar way she sees me.
lines.zh: 然而，我永远都不会懂，她看我的那种奇特方式。
